# Conake Browser v0.2.3

Sign in once with **Remember this device** checked to reopen your local profile automatically. Your operating system protects the saved unlock key. Choose **Lock** to forget automatic sign-in, or clear the checkbox on a shared computer. Linux requires an available system keyring.

Existing profiles use their current passwords, bookmarks and settings. Available for Windows x64, Linux x86_64 and macOS on Intel and Apple Silicon.

[Conake Studio downloads](https://conake.com/downloads)
